{{Current events|year=2025|month=02|day=26|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia]]
***The [[Somalia]]n [[Government of Somalia|government]] and the [[African Union]] finalize the troop distribution for the new [[peacekeeping]] mission [[African Union Support and Stabilization Mission in Somalia|AUSSOM]], resolving prior disputes with [[Ethiopian–Somali conflict|Ethiopia]] and later [[Burundi National Defence Force|Burundi]]. The mission will deploy 11,900 personnel, including [[soldier]]s, [[police]], and [[Staff (military)|civilian staff]]. Under the agreement, [[Uganda]] will contribute 4,500 troops, followed by [[Ethiopia]] with 2,500, [[Djibouti]] with 1,520, [[Kenya]] with 1,410, and [[Egypt]] with 1,091. [https://www.voanews.com/a/au-somalia-agree-on-troop-numbers-for-new-mission/7987913.html (VOA)]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023–present)|Sudanese civil war]], [[2024 famine in Sudan]]
**The [[United Nations]]-operated [[World Food Programme]] announces it has been forced to temporarily cease the distribution of [[humanitarian aid]] in the [[Zamzam refugee camp]] in [[North Darfur]], [[Sudan]], due to an [[conflict escalation|escalation in fighting]] between the [[Sudanese Armed Forces]] and the [[Rapid Support Forces]] in the region. [[Doctors Without Borders]] also temporarily ceased operations in the camp last week. [https://www.dw.com/en/sudan-un-food-agency-pauses-aid-in-famine-hit-refugee-camp/a-71763311 (DW)]
*[[Mexican drug war]]
**A [[Improvised explosive device|roadside bombing]] kills a [[Texas|Texan]] rancher in [[San Fernando, Tamaulipas]], [[Mexico]]. Authorities say the victim was driving on his ranch when the explosive device detonated. [https://www.elfinanciero.com.mx/border/2025/02/26/ranchero-de-texas-muere-por-explosivo-en-tamaulipas-advierten-que-carteles-amenazan-la-frontera/ (El Financiero)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Conservation and restoration of Pompeian frescoes]]
**Archeologists find monumental [[fresco]]es at the [[House of Thiasus]] in [[Pompeii]], [[Campania]], [[Italy]], providing insight into the [[Dionysian Mysteries]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/rare-frescoes-unearthed-pompeii-shed-light-ancient-rituals-2025-02-26/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2025 United States tariffs against the European Union]]
**[[President of the United States|United States President]] [[Donald Trump]] announces impending 25% [[Tariff|tariffs]] on the [[European Union]], which he states will be generally applied to sectors such as the [[Automotive industry|automotive industry]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2025/feb/26/trump-european-union-tariffs (''The Guardian'')]
*British [[petroleum industry|oil and gas]] company [[BP]] announces an agreement with the [[Iraq]]i [[government of Iraq|government]] to develop four [[oil field]]s around [[Kirkuk]] and increase production, with the value of BP's investment estimated at US$25 billion. [https://jpt.spe.org/bp-signs-deal-to-rehab-iraqs-kirkuk-oil-assets-boost-production (Society of Petroleum Engineers)] [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/iraq-bp-agree-develop-four-kirkuk-fields-iraqi-state-news-reports-2025-02-25/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Eighteen people are killed and thirty-one others are injured when a bus overturns in [[Prachinburi province]], [[Thailand]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/18-dead-in-a-bus-crash-in-eastern-thailand/ (CTV News)]
'''Health and environment'''
*An [[vaccine hesitancy|unvaccinated]] child dies of [[measles]] at a hospital in [[Lubbock]], [[Texas]], United States, as the first death since the disease was considered [[disease eradication|eradicated]] in the country in 2000. [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/1st-measles-death-linked-outbreak-texas-confirmed-child/story?id=119208967 (ABC News)] [https://apnews.com/article/measles-outbreak-west-texas-death-rfk-41adc66641e4a56ce2b2677480031ab9 (AP)]

'''International relations'''
*[[United States–Venezuela relations]]
**U.S. President [[Donald Trump]] cancels [[energy industry|energy]] corporation [[Chevron Corporation|Chevron]]'s [[petroleum licensing|license]] to operate in [[Venezuela]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/trump-orders-termination-oil-deal-with-venezuela-2025-02-26/ (Reuters)]
*[[United Nations]] [[Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights|Human Rights Commissioner]] [[Volker Türk]] condemns [[Israel]]'s [[human rights]] violations in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] and denounces [[Israeli settlements]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israel-has-shown-unprecedented-disregard-human-rights-gaza-un-human-rights-chief-2025-02-26/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2020 Nice stabbing]]
**[[2020 Nice stabbing#Perpetrator|Brahim Aouissaoui]], the perpetrator of the 2020 stabbing in [[Nice]], [[France]], is sentenced to [[life imprisonment]] without [[parole]]. [https://www.ctvnews.ca/world/article/a-tunisian-extremist-is-imprisoned-for-life-for-killing-3-people-in-a-french-basilica-in-2020/ (CTV News)]
*[[2025 Romanian presidential election]]
**[[Călin Georgescu]], the candidate received the most votes in the [[2024 Romanian presidential election|annulled 2024 presidential election]], is detained by [[Romanian Police|police]] and taken for questioning by the general prosecutor's office over allegations of false statements about financing sources, [[criminal possession of a weapon|illegal possession of weapons]], and forming an organization that is "[[fascist]], [[racist]], or [[xenophobic]]". [https://apnews.com/article/romania-calin-georgescu-528f1875e728f8a789f6622d224303a5 (AP)]
*[[Milorad Dodik]], [[president of Republika Srpska|President]] of [[Republika Srpska]], an [[Political divisions of Bosnia and Herzegovina|entity]] within [[Bosnia and Herzegovina]], is sentenced to one year in prison and banned from participating in politics for six years for "separatist actions", such as advocating for [[Proposed secession of Republika Srpska|secession]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/feb/26/pro-russia-bosnian-serb-president-milorad-dodik-jailed-for-separatist-actions (''The Guardian'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Anguillian general election]]
**The opposition [[Anguilla United Front]] (AUF) wins a majority in the [[House of Assembly (Anguilla)|House of Assembly]]. AUF leader [[Cora Richardson-Hodge]] becomes the first female [[Premier of Anguilla]]. [https://www.jamaicaobserver.com/2025/02/27/anguillians-elect-first-female-head-government/ (''Jamaica Observer'')]
*[[Freedom of the press in the United States]], [[Gulf of Mexico–America naming dispute]]
**The [[Second presidency of Donald Trump|Trump administration]] bans reporters from the [[Associated Press]], [[Reuters]], ''[[Der Tagesspiegel]]'', and ''[[HuffPost]]'' from the [[White House]] over their refusal to refer to the [[Gulf of Mexico]] as the "[[Executive Order 14172|Gulf of America]]". [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/white-house-bars-ap-reuters-other-media-covering-trump-cabinet-meeting-2025-02-26/ (Reuters)]
*[[Constitutional crisis in Somalia]]
**Somalia's [[Federal Parliament of Somalia|Federal Parliament]] fails to [[Meeting (parliamentary procedure)|meet]] due to a lack of [[quorum]], with only 137 [[member of parliament|MPs]] present, two short of the required amount. The delay raises concerns about a potential [[Motion of no confidence|no-confidence motion]] against [[List of prime ministers of Somalia|Prime Minister]] [[Hamza Abdi Barre]]'s [[Council of Ministers of Somalia|council of ministers]]. [https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2025/Feb/200428/somali_parliament_fails_to_meet_quorum_fueling_no_confidence_motion_speculation.aspx (Hiiraan Online)]
